preregistered.primary_metric: Instagram reach at the snapshot closest to 72h after posting (48h to 96h), divided by the median 72h reach of same-format posts published in the 28 days before start_date
preregistered.secondary_metric: Facebook distribution score read from Meta Business Suite once a week
preregistered.decision_rule: Move both slots to the afternoon window if the afternoon arm's median ratio is at least 0.30 higher than the usual arm's and a two-sided permutation test gives p < 0.10; keep the usual times if it is at least 0.30 lower; otherwise extend by 14 days
